notes.why: Config-locked evidence for the ETF L1 coverage metric. Every holding row was read from the issuer's own page/API on 2026-09-24 and every industry_code comes from the first-party TWSE/TPEx listed-company industry field; nothing here is an estimate.
notes.derivation: internal/sectormap derives the declared L1 targets from these rows; internal/sectorallocation re-derives them on every test run (TestETFRepresentatives_DerivationMatchesDeclaredTable), so a hand-edited table or a stale snapshot fails the build.
notes.excluded: Weights of positions whose industry code has no canonical L1 target are excluded and the remainder renormalised to 1; the uncovered percentage is reported per ETF in sectormap.ETFRepresentative.ReportedWeightPct - MappedWeightPct.
notes.other_assets: ReportedWeightPct is the sum of the equity rows only. Futures, cash and margin balances on the issuer pages are outside this snapshot and outside the L1 vector by construction.
